summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting unaudited interim financial information for the six months ended June 30, 2025, in compliance with NYSE Listed Company Manual Section 203.03. The filing contains interim condensed consolidated statements of comprehensive income and financial position, showing net loss attributable to owners of RMB 767 million for the period. No transaction, special event, or corporate action is described. This is a routine financial reporting requirement for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
